duties.onMiss: Run today's SEO iteration from program/brief.md in auto-sns-agent (apps/llm-wiki/content/sessions/2026/10/02/0040-virev-seo-agent/program), the work the 09:00 heartbeat did. Real-app fixes stay parked until the owner says 5180 is good enough (c40). duties.name: New articles get indexed
duties.onMiss: Work in auto-sns-agent, program folder apps/llm-wiki/content/sessions/2026/10/02/0040-virev-seo-agent/program. Fix a source_error first. No new article: find the land or CI run that holds the next built article and move it on a fresh ci/ branch (board s22); if none is in the pipeline, spawn the next one from p37's opportunities.md, one subagent per article. Unindexed: run the recrawl worker (workers/seo-recrawl/README.md) on sc-domain:virev.ai until Quota Exceeded. indexnow_unsent: run `uv run --project scripts/seo seo indexnow --new`. Overdue ledger check: score it with numbers; a loss gets a dated line in decisions.md (rewrite, merge or stop that topic). Staging lands are fine (c50); ask before a prod promote. No merge without the owner's go (c49) and nothing outside without his ok on a For you todo (c37). Do this on every run, met or missed, and tell the owner only what shipped or what needs him.
